scope: Corollary 3.2 (Product law) of the manuscript “Monochromatic finite sums and products in the positive integers” (preprints/Monochromatic-finite-sums-and-products-in-the-positive-integers-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 164 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab835f6a98c10d6d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let B = T ∪ {i} be a block, and let tj be the independent harmonic samples at its raw cutoffs. Let V = V (w) ≥ 1 be an auxiliary scale, and put KT = ∏︁ j∈T X2 j . If log Xi dominates every fixed power of 2 + W + KT + V , then ∥Law(tB) − νBµi∥1 = o(V −C ) for every fixed C > 0. (3.5) For any fixed family of disjoint blocks the corresponding joint law differs in the same sense from the product of their weighted pivot measures, when these hypotheses hold at each pivot.
